verdict.rationale: Otter documents a scheduled notetaker that auto-joins Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet. It also offers bot-free desktop recording on Mac and Windows and bot-free capture of impromptu Google Meet calls, and community users report recording all their work meetings with good accuracy. However, multiple hands-on reports describe the bot joining meetings the user did not intend and continuing to rejoin after attempts to stop it, which undercuts 'recording where I want it'. Missing for 10: reliable, documented per-meeting control over auto-join and recording, documented reliability for Teams and Zoom bot-free capture, and independent corroboration of cross-platform capture reliability.
